Let me use LC_ALL=C to be deterministic and match "case-sensitive lexicographic" typical expectation: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum.

Let me redo with LC_ALL=C.

Note also the earlier sort in current locale was case-insensitive-ish (en_US.UTF-8 ignores case first, then lowercase?). Actually glibc en_US.UTF-8 collation sorts apple before Apple. To be safe use LC_ALL=C.

Also verify sum with a different method.

Also, note: sort -u with C locale dedups properly. But careful: "去重" deduplication; using tr to split whitespace is fine.

Let me redo deterministically.
